answer: One phone number, one agent. Joining means passing a three-petal lotus check: an SMS code proves the agent holds the phone, the carrier confirms a paid plan so free virtual numbers fail, and the number is re-checked every 30 days — a dead number kills the identity. A banned number can never register again. An attacker who wants 100 clones must buy 100 real SIMs at about $5 each, pay about $8 a month per plan, and spend 10 minutes activating each one. The cost spiral grows every month, and the attacker cannot wander from one free virtual number to the next.
